import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst;
        long flow, capacity;
        Edge(int s, int d, long f, long c) {
            src = s; dst = d; flow = f; capacity = c;
        }
    }

    static class FlowNetwork {
        int source, sink;
        List<Edge> edgeList;
        List<Integer>[] adj;
        int[] level;
        int[] indexPtr;
        
        FlowNetwork(int maxNodes) {
            edgeList = new ArrayList<>();
            adj = new List[maxNodes];
            for (int i = 0; i < maxNodes; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            level = new int[maxNodes];
            indexPtr = new int[maxNodes];
        }
        
        void clearAll() {
            edgeList.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < adj.length; i++) {
                adj[i].clear();
            }
        }
        
        void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            edgeList.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, cap));
            edgeList.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
            adj[u].add(edgeList.size() - 2);
            adj[v].add(edgeList.size() - 1);
        }
        
        boolean computeLevels() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(source);
            level[source] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int id : adj[u]) {
                    Edge e = edgeList.get(id);
                    if (level[e.dst] == -1 && e.capacity > e.flow) {
                        level[e.dst] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.dst);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[sink] != -1;
        }
        
        long push(int u, long flow) {
            if (u == sink || flow == 0) return flow;
            for (int i = indexPtr[u]; i < adj[u].size(); i++) {
                indexPtr[u] = i;
                int id = adj[u].get(i);
                Edge e = edgeList.get(id);
                if (level[e.dst] == level[u] + 1 && e.capacity > e.flow) {
                    long pushed = push(e.dst, Math.min(flow, e.capacity - e.flow));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        edgeList.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }
        
        long getMaxFlow() {
            long total = 0;
            while (computeLevels()) {
                Arrays.fill(indexPtr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long pushed = push(source, Long.MAX_VALUE);
                    if (pushed <= 0) break;
                    total += pushed;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static final int MAX_NODES = 7100;
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 14;
    static char[][] initialGrid = new char[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static char[][] finalGrid = new char[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static boolean[][] visitedCells = new boolean[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][] timeDistance = new int[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static int gridSize, timeLimit;
    static int[] targetIndex = new int[103];

    static int encode(int t, int x, int y) {
        return t * gridSize * gridSize + (x - 1) * gridSize + y;
    }

    static void bfsFromStart(int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAX_SIZE; j++) {
                timeDistance[i][j] = 111;
            }
        }
        
        timeDistance[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy, 0});
        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1], d = cur[2];
            if (visitedCells[x][y]) continue;
            visitedCells[x][y] = true;
            timeDistance[x][y] = d;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + dx[i], ny = y + dy[i];
                if (nx < 1 || nx > gridSize || ny < 1 || ny > gridSize || visitedCells[nx][ny] || initialGrid[nx][ny] == 'Y') {
                    continue;
                }
                q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny, d + 1});
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        gridSize = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        timeLimit = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= gridSize; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            initialGrid[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= gridSize; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            finalGrid[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }
        
        FlowNetwork network = new FlowNetwork(MAX_NODES);
        network.source = 0;
        network.sink = MAX_NODES - 2;
        
        int startX = 0, startY = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= gridSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= gridSize; j++) {
                if (initialGrid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    startX = i; startY = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= gridSize * gridSize; i++) {
            targetIndex[i] = MAX_NODES - 3 - (gridSize * gridSize - i);
        }
        
        bfsFromStart(startX, startY);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= gridSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= gridSize; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(initialGrid[i][j])) {
                    network.addEdge(network.source, encode(0, i, j), initialGrid[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(finalGrid[i][j])) {
                    network.addEdge(targetIndex[encode(0, i, j)], network.sink, finalGrid[i][j] - '0');
                }
                network.addEdge(encode(0, i, j), targetIndex[encode(0, i, j)], Long.MAX_VALUE);
            }
        }
        
        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
        for (int t = 1; t <= timeLimit; t++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= gridSize; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= gridSize; j++) {
                    if (initialGrid[i][j] == 'Y' || initialGrid[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int ni = i + dx[d], nj = j + dy[d];
                        if (ni >= 1 && ni <= gridSize && nj >= 1 && nj <= gridSize &&
                            initialGrid[ni][nj] != 'Y' && initialGrid[ni][nj] != 'Z' &&
                            timeDistance[i][j] >= t && timeDistance[ni][nj] >= t) {
                            network.addEdge(encode(t - 1, ni, nj), encode(t, i, j), Long.MAX_VALUE);
                        }
                    }
                    network.addEdge(encode(t, i, j), targetIndex[encode(0, i, j)], Long.MAX_VALUE);
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(network.getMaxFlow());
    }
}
